description:
Check on the blockchain that a hash was anchored, by whom and when. Requires a paid API key.
With tx_hash and proof from a receipt, the check uses only chain data.

hash.description: The 64-character hex SHA-256 that was anchored
hash.title: Hash

proof.description: Optional: Merkle proof from the receipt
proof.title: Proof

tx_hash.description: Optional: transaction from the receipt, to verify without this server's index
tx_hash.title: Tx Hash

name: anchor_verify
title: Verify an anchor
